extracted.intended_audience: Microsoft Cloud customers, partners, industry professionals, and readers looking for industry-specific Microsoft Cloud news and resources
extracted.subtask_description: A news-listing page for the Microsoft Cloud Blog that lets users find industry-specific blog posts by filtering and sorting (industry, content type, topic, date). Useful for researching recent Microsoft announcements, case studies, and events relevant to particular sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sort By
rubrics_metrics.description: Sort By Relevance / Newest to oldest / Oldest to newest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Controls the ordering of results. Use 'Relevance' to surface most-topically-matching items, 'Newest to oldest' to prioritize recent announcements, and 'Oldest to newest' to review historical posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter posts by industry (examples listed: Energy and resources, Mining, Oil and gas, Power and utilities, Financial services, Banking, Capital markets, Insurance, General, Government, Defense and intelligence, Government operations and infrastructure, Public finance, Public health and social services, Public safety and justice, Sovereignty, Healthcare, Payors, Providers, Manufacturing, Media and entertainment, Mobility, Automotive, Transport and logistics, Retail and consumer goods, Telecommunications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select one or more industry facets to narrow content to sector-relevant news and case studies. The page shows counts per industry to indicate volume (e.g., Healthcare (44), Financial services (21)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Content Type
rubrics_metrics.description: Content Type options shown: Customer stories, Events, News, Thought leadership (with counts displayed, e.g., Customer stories (13), Events (31), News (224), Thought leadership (11)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the appropriate content type to filter results by format and intent — e.g., pick 'News' for announcements, 'Customer stories' for case studies, 'Events' for conference-related posts, and 'Thought leadership' for opinion/analysis pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Topic filters include tags such as AI resources, Frontier Transformation, Trustworthy AI, and other topical groupings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use topic tags to surface posts focused on specific themes (for example, all posts related to AI resources or Microsoft’s Frontier Transformation). Topic filters help find thematic content across industries and content types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish date
rubrics_metrics.description: Date filters: Last 3 Months, Last 6 Months, Last 12 Months, or Custom (Start Date / End Date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restrict results to a recent timeframe or a custom date range to locate timely announcements or to compile historical timelines of announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refine Results / Filtered by / Clear All
rubrics_metrics.description: UI controls for applying and clearing multiple filters: 'Refine Results', shows 'Filtered by' selections, and 'Clear All' to reset filters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine multiple filters (industry + content type + topic + date) to precisely target the subset of posts you need; use 'Clear All' to remove filters and broaden results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article listing metadata and preview
rubrics_metrics.description: Each article listing displays title, publish date, estimated read time (e.g., '5 min read', '7 min read'), and a short summary blurb.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scan the title, date, read time, and teaser to quickly judge relevance and depth of an article (e.g., announcements vs. long-form analysis). The presence of 'News' label and read-time helps prioritize which items to open for full details or for drafting press-material summaries.
